### 🟡 Changes recommended The new netlink-policy check can report false failures for unset/denylist `RestrictAddressFamilies`, and the new real-systemd test can be flaky due to unchecked random port selection. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR addresses a Linux/systemd startup failure where sing-box exits during route-update subscription because the hardened systemd sandbox disallows `AF_NETLINK`. It updates the systemd hardening policy and adds a stronger “real startup” preflight to catch route-monitor failures before enabling the service. **Changes:** - Allow `AF_NETLINK` in both the installed `sb-sing-box.service` and the transient `systemd-run` preflight sandbox. - Add a runtime (real startup) preflight that starts sing-box briefly under the production-equivalent systemd sandbox; extend `sb repair` and `sb doctor` accordingly. - Bump version to `0.1.0-alpha.5` and update docs/changelog plus systemd regression tests.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | VERSION | Bump project version to `0.1.0-alpha.5`. | | lib/common.sh | Update default `SBM_VERSION` fallback to `0.1.0-alpha.5`. | | setup.sh | Allow `AF_NETLINK` in service hardening and run the new runtime preflight during install/start. | | lib/runtime-security.sh | Allow `AF_NETLINK` in transient preflight; add `systemd_runtime_preflight` and netlink-policy probe helper. | | lib/doctor.sh | Add runtime preflight to repair flow; add explicit AF_NETLINK policy check to `sb doctor`. | | tests/systemd-exec-smoke.sh | Assert transient `systemd-run` includes `AF_NETLINK` in `RestrictAddressFamilies`. | | tests/systemd-real-exec.sh | Add real PID-1 systemd test that runs sing-box under the sandbox with a generated config. | | tests/install-smoke.sh | Update version assertion to `0.1.0-alpha.5`. | | README.md | Document Debian/systemd netlink route-listen requirement and update version references. | | CHANGELOG.md | Add `0.1.0-alpha.5` release notes describing AF_NETLINK + new preflight/tests. |
